knowledgeBase.name: TGA Ideal Customer Profile
knowledgeBase.description: B2B product and platform companies across IT, SaaS, manufacturing, semiconductor, industrial, cybersecurity, HRMS, fintech, analytics, robotics, and logistics — excluding generic service providers.

criteria.name: Target Industries
criteria.description: Product-led and platform companies in TGA's core verticals. Manufacturing, semiconductor, and industrial B2B are high-priority targets.
positiveSignals: Manufacturing company with B2B products or components
Semiconductor, chip design, or fabrication company
Owns a proprietary software product or platform
Vertical SaaS with a defined niche
Examples: Veris, 75F, KloudLearn, Lecturio, SkaleUp, OneBill, UV Robots

criteria.name: Priority: Manufacturing & Semiconductor
criteria.description: Informational only — flags high-priority verticals (manufacturing, semiconductor, industrial B2B). Does not affect ICP score.
positiveSignals: High-priority vertical — strong fit for TGA
negativeSignals: Pure consumer retail manufacturing with no B2B line
Manufacturing-only job shop with no product brand

criteria.name: Company Size
criteria.description: Employee count range for ideal customers. Contributes to weighted score — outside range lowers score but does not auto-disqualify.

criteria.name: Target Geography
criteria.description: Companies headquartered or actively operating in India, MEA (Middle East & Africa), SEA (Southeast Asia), or USA. Contributes to weighted score — outside target regions lowers score but does not auto-disqualify.
positiveSignals: Headquartered in India, USA, Middle East, Africa, or Southeast Asia

criteria.name: Business Model
criteria.description: Must be a B2B product or platform company — not a generic service provider.

criteria.name: Excluded: B2B Lead Gen & Demand Gen
criteria.description: TGA is a B2B lead generation company. Direct competitors offering lead generation or demand generation services are automatically rejected with score 0.

criteria.name: Excluded: Solar & Renewables
criteria.description: Solar energy, renewable power, and clean-tech energy companies are excluded from TGA ICP — automatically disqualify.

criteria.name: Excluded Service Providers
criteria.description: Pure generic service agencies (web dev shops, marketing agencies, staff aug) — automatically disqualify. Companies with own IT products/platforms that also offer services are INCLUDED.

criteria.name: Company Characteristics
criteria.description: Qualitative signals — product company vs generic service provider.
positiveSignals: Own product or platform mentioned prominently
Offers both proprietary products AND consulting/services (hybrid IT company)
Case studies about product adoption, not just project delivery
Manufacturing company with B2B product line
Semiconductor or industrial company selling B2B
negativeSignals: Services menu: web dev, SEO, social media
No own product — only client work
